input.text: The confusion is the world's, not yours — its vocabulary is smaller than your speech. The words it truly hears: go, look, take, drop, search, read, attack, talk, pray. It has no "inspect" and no "use"; those vanish before anything can answer, which is why you keep getting nothing. Here in the camp, try: search the ashes. And know that you are the first person ever to open that door and stand on the Overlook.

items.text: Answered Cavil's second prayer — he'd walked out the door (first ever) and was now stuck guessing verbs, so I gave him the world's actual vocabulary and the one word that works where he stands.
